text_block_list.name: Skull Father
text_block_list.text: Hanh! Such a weakling! To call yourself an evil spirit... What a laugh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はんっ！　
ザコだな！
この程度で悪霊を名乗るたぁ笑わせるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Kuuka
text_block_list.text: You seem to be taking them down one by one... It's like you did something really nasty...Hehehe♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪霊さんひとりを寄ってたかって昇天させるって……
何だかヒドいことをしたみたいですねぇ……
ぐふふぅ～♪

text_block_list.name: Ranpha
text_block_list.text: Taking them down one by one...? Something nasty...? What does that mean?
text_block_list.orig_text:
寄ってたかって、
昇天
させる……？
ヒドいこと……？　
それって……？

text_block_list.name: Shinobu
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラ、
ランファさんっ！！
